Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing vehicles with hydraulics to operate on public roadways.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing vehicles with hydraulics to operate onpublic roadways; and adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person shall not raise or lower the height of a motor vehicleby mechanical means while the motor vehicle is in motion on a publicroadway with a posted speed limit of twentyfive miles per hour orgreater and with the vehicle speed in excess of fifteen miles per hour.At no time shall any portion of any tire leave the surface of theroadway or any component of the hydraulic system cause or emit sparks.An operator receiving three or more citations for violating thissection will be required to remove all hydraulics from the vehicle. (2) Nothing in this section prohibits a county or city fromenacting stricter regulations for hydraulic vehicles on a publicroadway.
